content: sabre/vobject (5.0.0 released 2026-07-07): TimeZoneUtil maps MS names (GMT Standard Time->Europe/London) but on failure silently returns PHP default timezone unless failIfUncertain=true. VCalendar::expand() defaults timezone to UTC (floating times interpreted as UTC), strips VTIMEZONE, throws if recurring VEVENT lacks UID, throws MaxInstancesExceededException beyond Settings::maxRecurrences=3500.
